description: This file defines the `Downloader` class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Helper namespace. It provides methods for handling file downloads, including setting appropriate headers, validating file accessibility, and managing content types. The class is designed to facilitate the downloading of spreadsheet files in various formats.

classes.name: Downloader
classes.description: Helper class for downloading spreadsheet files with proper headers and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Downloader with folder, filename, and optional filetype. Validates folder and file accessibility.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Sends headers and outputs the file for download.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for file download, including content type, content disposition, cache controls, and file size.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header based on file extension.

methods.name: contentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header to attachment with filename.

methods.name: fileSize
methods.description: Sets the Content-Length header based on file size.
